comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
From the limited time recipe "Landsknecht Clothing Patterns" (available during World Clock: 15th Century, Phases 4 and 5) -- speak to Item Shop's Shopkeeper. R14 Sewing required.

Ingredients:
Cotton Fabric x20
Lace x20
Leather Cord x20
5k total fame to equip, no gender restrictions, color-custom.

Stats: +1 Swordplay

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?WorldClock/item
Images: eririndol.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-59.html

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body:
I made this clothes with the Age Effect Item 15C Bonnet de Marianne EX, also I found the recipe appeared with 16C Age Item Knight's Stiletto EX. This recipe disappeared when I remove "Knight's Stiletto EX" from my toon. So a certain 16C ?? can make us craft the outfit except 16C 5.

The recipe should have appeared if the required age included 16C 5 since the World Clock atm points out 16C 5 however, the recipe didn't appear when I didn' equip "Stilletto EX".

In short, this Recipe requires
15C 4, 5
16C ?? except 5 phase.

wiki:
You can craft/enhance the outfit at Bremen (Shopkeeper).
Required Age: 15C 4, 15C 5 or Age Effect Item (15C or 16C)

1st Recipe: Landsknecht Clothing Patterns (check the recipe below!)

2nd Recipe(after 7 Wonders CH3.5 Babylon Update)
Tailoring Mercenary Clothes

Required Skill: Sewing 15R / Handicrafts 10R
Landsknecht Clothing + Fine Dye X 5 + Luxury Flax Yarn X 1
Result: Landsknecht Clothing (Attack number will be incrased)

You can increase the attack number up to 100 without failure.

Sample Cases)

Landsknecht Clothing(A 47/D17): spent Luxury Flax Yarn X 15 / Master's secret X 15
Landsknecht Clothing(A 45/D15): spent Luxury Flax Yarn X 19 / Master's secret X 18
